exposure: referral from peripheral hospital during labor
cohort: 2,628 referred patients in labor admitted to the Labor Room of Obstetrics & Gynaecology Department of M.K.C.G. Medical College and Hospital, Berhampur, Odisha, India, between September 2017 and September 2019.
finding: The most common cause of referral was fetal distress (28.7%), followed by obstructed labor (21%), and vaginal delivery was the primary mode of delivery (55.4%) compared to Cesarean section (44%), with postpartum hemorrhage (22.8%) being the most common maternal complication and birth asphyxia (28.9%) the most common perinatal complication.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery (55.4%) was the primary mode of delivery compared to Caeserean section (44%).
